notes.title: Fallalypse Universe Unites
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742740/fbe761ece9098b76625d6f9fb608b51d19f26ba5.jpg[/img]We decided to conduct a small experiment by combining two games from the same [b]Fallalypse Universe[/b]. Now players who buy [url=store.steampowered.com/app/1051630]Memorial Park[/url] and [url=store.steampowered.com/app/978610]Disconnect[/url] when traveling around the world of Disconnect may come across the cemetery with their grave created in Memorial Park. 

It seems to us that this introduces some interesting and unusual context into [url=store.steampowered.com/app/978610]Disconnect[/url] and in general into [b]the game Universe of Fallalypse[/b]. So in this destroyed world there's a random chance that you can get to the old graveyard with the grave created by you in [url=store.steampowered.com/app/1051630]Memorial Park[/url].

[h1]To sum up:[/h1]

1.[i] Buy both games:[/i]
[list]
[*] https://store.steampowered.com/app/978610
[*] https://store.steampowered.com/app/1051630
[/list]
2. [i]Travel across the game world of [url=store.steampowered.com/app/978610]Disconnect[/url]. And you can randomly find a graveyard location. There you can gather resources and visit your own grave from [url=store.steampowered.com/app/1051630]Memorial Park[/url].[/i]https://store.steampowered.com/app/978610

notes.title: Photogrammetric Statue of Victor Noir
notes.notes:
We've added the photogrammetric statue of Victor Noir to the project:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742740/8fb0cf8360ca2d09965d59e6dddeca6aebf33f9d.png[/img]

Victor Noir, (27 July 1848 in Attigny, Vosges – 11 January 1870 in Paris), was a French journalist who is famous for the manner of his death and its political consequences. His tomb in the Père Lachaise Cemetery in Paris later became a fertility symbol.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742740/0b33dbba768119bdc8e542f06b0665ba6945a8c9.png[/img]

A life-sized bronze statue was sculpted by Jules Dalou to mark his grave, portrayed in a realistic style as though he had just fallen on the street, dropping his hat which is depicted beside him.

The sculpture has a very noticeable protuberance in Noir's trousers. This has made it one of the most popular memorials for women to visit in the famous cemetery. Myth says that placing a flower in the upturned top hat after kissing the statue on the lips and rubbing its genital area will enhance fertility, bring a blissful sex life, or, in some versions, a husband within the year. As a result of the legend, those particular components of the otherwise verdigris (grey-green oxidized bronze) statue are rather well-worn and shiny.

The statue in the project is photogrammetric so it's very realistic and as close to the original as possible.
